nodes.name: _summary-v6-kappa.json
nodes.summary: Machine-generated summary artifact capturing the results of the Manifest v6 inter-rater kappa re-calibration run, including pairwise Cohen's kappa values across three judge pairs (Opus/GPT/MiniMax), confusion matrices, per-cell kappa breakdowns, and MiniMax operational metrics (latency, cost, token counts).
nodes.languageNotes: JSON summary artifact produced by the benchmark calibration pipeline; top-level keys map directly to statistical metrics and confusion matrix arrays used by the analysis documents in this directory.

nodes.name: kappa-v6-analysis.md
nodes.summary: Detailed technical analysis of the Manifest v6 inter-rater agreement calibration run with 6 sections covering three pairwise Cohen's kappa scores, a PASS verdict (κ_conservative_trio=0.7878 ≥ 0.70), confusion matrices for all judge pairs, per-cell kappa breakdowns (n=20 per cell), MiniMax operational metrics, and comparison to the v5 historical baseline.

nodes.name: v6-kappa-memo.md
nodes.summary: Exit memo summarising the Manifest v6 Phase 1 kappa re-calibration outcome (PASS, κ_conservative_trio=0.7878), reproducing key statistics from the analysis in a concise format with a PM next-step directive for unblocking the main benchmark run.
